verdict.rationale: Docusign's own AI-Assisted Review has an AI-powered chat for analyzing, redlining and drafting agreements, and signers get AI Q&A. Docusign also ships an official MCP server/connector, so assistants like Claude or Gemini CLI can query agreement status and trigger workflow actions in plain language. General natural-language operation, however, runs through third-party assistants rather than a native command interface, and the native chat covers only review and drafting. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for core operations (sending, routing, managing envelopes), documented breadth of actions available via natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
